sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION If
you invest in ADSs, you will experience immediate dilution to the extent of the difference between the price per ADS paid by investors
in this offering and the net tangible book value per ADS immediately after the offering. Our
net tangible book value per Ordinary Share is determined by dividing our total shareholders’ equity (less intangible assets, if
any) by the actual number of outstanding Ordinary Shares. The net tangible book value of our Ordinary Shares as of June 30, 2026, was
approximately $0.004 per Ordinary Share or approximately $0.032 per ADS (using the ratio of eight (8) Class A Ordinary Shares
to one ADS). After
